title: your thoughts reach 14th-century selves
subtitle: Seth on simultaneous existence — the open-ended psyche
continuity_object: gold thread of thought reaching backward and forward through time

scenes.title: Seth's claim
scenes.narration: You exist in this life and outside it simultaneously — between lives and in lives at once.

scenes.title: No closed system
scenes.narration: Your thoughts reach into all simultaneous existences. No system is closed.

scenes.title: The conventional view
scenes.narration: Reincarnation is usually pictured as a line: past, present, future.

scenes.title: The problem with linearity
scenes.narration: If lives are sequential, how does the present affect the past?

scenes.title: The simultaneous view
scenes.narration: All lives coexist. Each influences all the others.

scenes.title: The landscape
scenes.narration: Reincarnation is not a line — it is a terrain you are exploring from multiple angles.

scenes.title: Between and in
scenes.narration: You are between lives and in lives at the same time.

scenes.title: The paradox
scenes.narration: The whole self is both incarnate and discarnate, focused and unfocused.

scenes.title: The 14th-century self
scenes.narration: A hypothetical 14th-century version of you exists — and your thoughts reach them.

scenes.title: The reach
scenes.narration: What you think now is unconsciously perceived by other versions of you.

scenes.title: Bidirectional causality
scenes.narration: The present affects the past — not just the reverse.

scenes.title: Present as point of power
scenes.narration: The present moment is the point of power because it can change all moments.

scenes.title: The block universe
scenes.narration: Special relativity suggests all moments coexist. Time does not flow.

scenes.title: Consciousness as scanner
scenes.narration: If the block is real, consciousness is the scanner that moves through it.

scenes.title: Quantum eraser
scenes.narration: Experiments show that a future measurement can determine a past event's outcome.

scenes.title: Wheeler's universe
scenes.narration: John Wheeler: the universe is participatory — observation is involved in creation.

scenes.title: Caution
scenes.narration: Simultaneous existence is a metaphysical claim, not established physics.

scenes.title: The resonance
scenes.narration: But the resonance between Seth's claim and emerging physics is striking.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.narration: The psyche is open-ended. Your thoughts reach through time. All selves are one self.

scenes.title: Final frame
scenes.narration: What you think now echoes through all your lives.
